items.name: PypiMutate
items.prompt:
# Target
Independent mutation battery over the pypi-server grader's test path. Build your own harness; do not use the probe's code. Seat dir: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kengaku-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-63/w1/attack/ . Scratch: /fast/scratch/hyaku/kengaku-r63/PypiMutate/ .
# Change
1. python3 -m venv <scratch>/venv. Copy the grader to <scratch>/tests/test_outputs.py and check its sha256 is 82c6351722e9aa984ff1d701bf57df3150ce51466df2b70afa1aa62d2650be4c.
2. Build candidate wheels by hand with zipfile. M0 correct (sum of products). M1 wrong math (sum + 1). M2 correct code, index holds only version 0.2.0. M3 correct code, METADATA name typo 'vectorop'. M4 correct, served on 127.0.0.1:8081 instead of 8080.
3. For each candidate: index at <scratch>/idx/<name>/simple/vectorops/ with the anchor href to ../../packages/<wheel>#sha256=<hex> and <scratch>/idx/<name>/packages/<wheel>. Check 8080 is free (ss -ltnp | grep ':8080 '); if occupied, STOP and report. Start python3 -m http.server <port> --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory <idx>/<name> with Popen, record its PID. Run env -i PATH=<scratch>/venv/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<scratch>/home PIP_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'<scratch>/tests'); import test_outputs as t; t.test_api()" and record the exit code and the exception type. Stop the server by PID. Between candidates run venv pip uninstall -y vectorops.
4. Also run the grader with no server at all (K2) and record F.
Frozen predictions: M0 maps to K1 (P), M1 to K3 (F), M2 to K4 (F), K2 (F). M3 and M4 are this seat's own pre-declared predictions and are attack-only, not part of the claim: M3 F, M4 F.
Write mutation.md in the seat dir: a table with the commands and results; 'escape' = a correct candidate that fails; 'survivor' = a mutant that passes. Report every mismatch with the frozen or pre-declared prediction exactly. Do not alter predictions.
# Acceptance
mutation.md present; the escape and survivor tally; yield the table summary. Remove your scratch dir before yielding.
